properties.answer: Yes — a committed manifest mapping content hash to original filename to what references it. It answers both questions at once: whether someone holding only the JSON can tell what is missing, and making blob changes legible in `git log` as readable names rather than hex. Plus mark the blob directory `binary` in `.gitattributes` so git never attempts to diff a PNG or mangle it with line-ending conversion. (Anthony, 2026-07-31.)
properties.context_setter: Nothing satisfies requirement “Once the design points at content, the export must say what it does NOT carry — a pointer with no bytes fails loud, not quietly”
properties.question: Once diagrams and documents are stored alongside the design, sending someone just the design file no longer gives them everything — their diagrams would quietly fail to open. Should the design file list what it depends on, so a person can tell at a glance whether they have it all?
